name: jacobian
title: Numerical Jacobian, with one column for each component of x.

origin.description: Numerical Jacobian, with one column for each component of x.
origin.details: Numerical Jacobian, with one column for each component of x.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(numDeriv))
func2 <- function(x) c(sin(x), cos(x))
jacobian(func2, (0:1) * 2 * pi)

translation.description: Numerical Jacobian, with one column for each component of x.
translation.details: Numerical Jacobian, with one column for each component of x.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from numderiv import jacobian
print(jacobian(lambda x: np.concatenate([np.sin(x), np.cos(x)]), np.arange(2) * 2 * np.pi))
